items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I knew guys like Orry Kelly and -- I knew all of them.

ctx.x: This was before Mickey Cohen, you know, but it was called the Club Bali, and I worked there -- oh, I worked there for about a year, and the star of the show was

a guy named Burrows Fletcher, and of course I was just sort of an atmosphere piano player, you know. And I used to do a thing -- I used to do Fats Waller's, "You're Feets Too Big," and I met an awful lot of people there, and I made a lot of wonderful friends with the people in the industry, you know, and most of these guys that used to come in there were designers, you know, and stars and people that were very, very prominent people. And I worked there for about a year, and I -- well, I knew guys like Orry Kelly…

She had been working there, and at that time Lillian Randolph was going -- was going into acting and doing -- she was on the Great Gildersleeve. She was going into, you know, the radio thing, shows and whatever. And so she was sort of getting away from the nightclub thing. She had been working there for quite a while, and they wanted somebody -- they wanted a girl. They told her they'd like to have somebody -- a girl to play and sing. So she, being a friend of mine, she recommended me for this job, and the guy…
